youtube.title: Shakespeare's wife had the best comeback 💅 #shorts
youtube.caption:
William Shakespeare left his wife ONE thing in his will... his second best bed. 🛏️💀

She got the bed. She also got the last word.

Who do you think got the BEST bed? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on Shakespeare's real 1616 will, which leaves his wife Anne "my second best bed with the furniture" and most everything else to their daughter Susanna.

#shakespeare #williamshakespeare #historymemes #funnyhistory #englishliterature #history #shorts
